item.title: visualstudio: Stop waiting on a failed build
item.description:
Visual Studio now stops solution builds after the first project failure, so you can return to fixing the error sooner. The change reduces time spent waiting for the rest of the build to finish after an error has already occurred.

  • Source: Visual Studio Blog

item.title: visualstudio: New Tools, New Workflows and the Value of the Visual Studio Subscription: What We Learned at VSLive! San Diego
item.description:
At VSLive! San Diego, Microsoft discussed how developers are changing their coding workflows and learning new skills with Visual Studio and related tools. The post also highlights the value of a Visual Studio Subscription for expanding access to development resources.

  • Source: Visual Studio Blog

item.title: visualstudio: What Would You Build in Azure If You Didn’t Have to Ask for a Budget First?
item.description:
The post says eligible Visual Studio subscribers may already have access to a personal Azure sandbox, making it easier to try .NET apps, serverless, containers, proofs of concept, or unfamiliar Azure services without requesting a budget first.

  • Source: Visual Studio Blog
